slots.workflow-matrix/title: Release decisions depend on validated measures, controls, runbooks, and recovery
slots.workflow-matrix/matrix-takeaway/text: Pilot and expansion decisions depend on validated evidence and operational readiness; candidate targets remain hypotheses.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-0: Discovery produces validated baseline and sampling notes. Record the sampling window, definitions, exclusions and owner alongside each baseline measure.
It also produces a journey and ownership map, interface and dependency register, prioritized thin-release backlog, and agreed control and acceptance checklist.
The discovery baseline is assumed, not independently validated.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-1: Pilot measures include intake completeness, manual handoffs, decision latency, rework, and recoverability. Keep each measure definition and case population stable between baseline and pilot.

Candidate targets are manual handoffs from the assumed 22% toward 12%, incomplete intake from the assumed 14% toward 7%, and at least 95% traceability to an owner and timestamp. Population: pilot case-state transitions.
The candidate targets are directional hypotheses, not performance commitments.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-2: Proceed to pilot only after owners accept test evidence, critical control findings are resolved, operations can run the runbooks, and rollback is rehearsed.

Review control findings, operational runbooks and recovery rehearsal with the owners before authorizing a bounded pilot. For any unresolved item, record the owner, evidence needed and decision date before steering review.
Record unresolved findings, accountable owners and the proceed / hold decision.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-3: Proceed to expansion only when validated baseline and pilot data support the decision.
If evidence is weak or conditions change, adjust scope and retain the existing service.
Record the expansion decision, scope changes and recovery owner.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-4: Target values require agreed definitions and validated baseline data. Use a common denominator and include data limitations in steering materials.
Do not declare success from activity completion alone.
Confirm measure definitions, sample coverage, ownership and decision cadence with the steering committee.
slots.slide/takeaway: Pilot evidence—not activity completion—determines whether to proceed, adjust, or hold.
